decisions.reason: The Air Quality Bricklet has its own product page and was publicly launched as part of the firm's Baukastensystem, creating high sunk costs and public commitment that make dropping unlikely.

As the third generation replacing an established product, the Analog In Bricklet 3.0 carries cumulative investment and public commitment to the product line, so management persists despite any disappointing results.
The CAN bus interface module is less visibly promoted than other modules, but it is still part of the modular system and has accumulated development costs, leading management to continue it.
The CO2 sensor module has a dedicated product page and is central to the air quality product family, so high escalation of commitment keeps it on the market.
